notes.title: Big News: Cozy Garden is Transforming into Pixel Art!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

I’m the art director of Cozy Garden, and I wanted to share some exciting news. A while ago, I noticed that the Steam community seems to love Pixel Art—and honestly, I agree with you! I want to create the best game possible alongside my friend, so I decided to change everything.

All the artwork is now being transformed into Pixel Art. To help with this, we brought in a talented friend of ours (I know my limits, haha). He’s been converting all the original artwork into beautiful Pixel Art, and it’s looking amazing!

There’s still some work left to do, but you can already check out what we’ve been working on over the past few months. We’ve also redesigned the characters to make them more cohesive with the gorgeous new art style.

I hope you enjoy the changes!
